title: UDM closure scan and bounded Python fixtures
question: What do the 33 saved findings establish about the current generator and reader code closures?
method: Reproduce all four exact site lists and compare synthetic Python workloads with independent expected results from fresh interpreters.
conclusion: The diagnostic site lists match exactly. Bounded fixtures show one uninvoked dynamic site reported, a determining initializer correctly preventing narrowing, and an indirect import that changes the result without changing its reported complete identity. No production reuse qualified.
